articles.summary: NEW YORK, November 12, 2024 /PRNewswire/ — Lument Finance Trust, Inc. (NYSE: LFT) (“we”, “LFT” or “the Company”) today reported its third quarter results. GAAP net income attributable to common shareholders for the third quarter was $5.1 million, or $0.10 per share of common stock.
